notes.title: Hot Fix #3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] achievements are now achievable 
[*] can no longer walk into the void and beyond
[*] the letter properly hides itself
[*] "RESUME" button goes back to "START" if progress is reset
[*] "RESET PROGRESS" button actually resets progress
[*] replaced the clock batteries
[*] minor amendments to the content file
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who has reported bugs in the past days. Your efforts are greatly appreciated.

Artificial Entertainment
